parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to start displaying from in the response. Minimum value: 1.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the edge instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page in the response. Maximum value: 30. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10.
